## Security audit

Every pull request is security audited before it is merged into `main`, and the audit is logged in [security-log/](../security-log/) in CSAF 2.0 format (ISO/IEC 20153). The maintainer runs the audit and adds the log. You don't need to do anything, but it helps if you note below anything that touches file paths, settings parsing, threading, the Qt context bar or the CI workflows.
